thread.title: Apple stock price target trimmed from $205 to $200; Morgan Stanley

author: Daniel Stone
title: Apple stock price target trimmed from $205 to $200; Morgan Stanley
text:
January 25, 2018 Apple stock price target trimmed from $205 to $200; Morgan Stanley 
Morgan Stanley Analyst cut the price target of Apple Inc. (AAPL) Stock from $205 to $200 today. Apple shares edged Up 0.45% in Thursday’s Pre-Market Activity. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s stock on Wednesday traded at beginning with a price of $ 177.25 and when day-trade ended the stock finally plunged -1.59% to reach at $174.22. Analyst’s mean target price for AAPL is $188.46 while analysts mean recommendation is 1.80. Stock value has moved between $119.33 – 179.61 in last one year. 
Analyst’s ratings play a very important role in outlining a stock’s performance. Let us check out how analysts have ranked AAPL based on current scenarios. Stock has got OUTPERFORM rating from 15 analyst(s) whereas last month 17 analyst(s) have given outperform rating. SELL rating has been given by 0 analyst(s) and 16 analyst(s) given BUY rating to the stock. Company fiscal year is ending in September and analysts’ consensus recommendation is Outperform for AAPL and estimated EPS for next quarter is 4.16. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) yearly performance is 45.22% and net profit margin is 21.10%. Annual EPS Growth of past 5 years is 7.90%. The current share price indicates that stock is -3.26% away from its one year high and is moving 45.79% ahead of its 52-week low. About Daniel Stone
